journal: Fixture Journal With A Capped Allowance

article_types.description: A substantial novel research study, with a complex story often involving several techniques or approaches.
article_types.structure: Title (≤10 words or 90 characters), Abstract (≤150 words, unreferenced, no heading), Introduction (no heading), Results, Discussion, Methods
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 6 display items (figures and/or tables).

article_types.description: A new analysis of existing data, or new data obtained in a comparative analysis, leading to novel and arresting conclusions of importance to a broad audience.
article_types.structure: Title (≤10 words or 90 characters), Abstract (≤150 words, unreferenced, no heading), Introduction (no heading), Results, Discussion, Methods
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 6 display items (figures and/or tables).

article_types.description: Presents a large data set of broad utility, interest and significance to the community.
article_types.structure: Title (≤10 words or 90 characters), Abstract (≤150 words, unreferenced, no heading), Introduction (no heading), Results, Discussion, Methods
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 6 display items (figures and/or tables).

article_types.description: Reports a concise study of high quality and broad interest.

total_word_limit.notes: No subheadings within the main text.

article_types.structure: Title (≤10 words or 90 characters), Abstract (≤70 words, 3 sentences, unreferenced), Methods (≤500 words)
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 2 display items, flexible at editor discretion if page limit observed.

article_types.description: Forum for comment on issues relevant to the journal's community -- not for presenting research data or analysis. Technical comments on peer-reviewed papers go through Matters Arising instead.

An authoritative, balanced and scholarly survey of recent developments in a research field; not dominated by a single laboratory's work. Mostly editor-invited; unsolicited proposals considered via a 1-2 page synopsis submission (Synopsis-Review option). A study using a structured, replicable literature-extraction method is reclassified as original research and should follow the Article/Analysis format instead.
article_types.figures_tables: Up to 6 display items. Illustrations strongly encouraged.

article_types.description: A forum for authors to discuss models and ideas from a personal viewpoint -- more forward-looking/speculative than Reviews, may take a narrower field of view, may advocate a controversial position. Mostly editor-invited; unsolicited proposals considered via a 1-2 page synopsis submission (Synopsis-Perspective option).

Opinionated pieces on a topical issue in sustainability research, policy or societal debate -- agenda-setting, authoritative, can be provocative but must road-map a proposed solution, not just describe a problem. Mostly editor-invited; unsolicited proposals considered via a 1-page synopsis submission (Synopsis-Comment option).
article_types.figures_tables: Figures/diagrams encouraged, not required; does not normally contain primary research data.
